name: ZCA_EXP_JOBS
description: The table contains one record per defined bulk export job.

columns.name: EXPORT_JOB_ID
columns.description: Primary Key.

columns.name: JOB_PARAMETERS
columns.description: This columns containts details regarding the job parameters.

columns.name: EMAIL_ADDRESS
columns.description: Email Address for sending email notification of export activity completion

columns.name: MASS_UPDATE_DTL_ID
columns.description: Mass Update Detail Id for Export Jobs

columns.name: HIERARCHY_PARENT_OBJ_CD
columns.description: Contains Parent Object Code for Hierarchy JOB

columns.name: ZIP_FILE_NAME
columns.description: Maintains zip file name for hierarchy job

columns.name: ENABLE_SPLIT
columns.description: Stores final zip file splitting enabled or not - YES/NO

columns.name: ENABLE_EXPORT_ATTACHMENTINFO
columns.description: Export Attachment info of Export object -YES/NO

columns.name: SPLIT_SIZE
columns.description: Stores split size number parent records exporting in zip file

columns.name: HIERARCHY_PARENT_OBJ_ID
columns.description: Maintains parent object ID for hierarchy job

columns.name: INITIAL_EXTRACT_FILTER_TM
columns.description: This field saves the Intial Date time of the interval between which the data export has to happen.

columns.name: MODULE_ID
columns.description: Seed Data Framework: indicates the module that owns the row. A module is an entry in Application Taxonomy such as a Logical Business Area. When the MODULE_ID column exists and the owner of the row is not specified, then the Seed Data Framework will not extract the row as seed data.

columns.name: EXPORT_JOB_NUMBER
columns.description: Alternate Key for Export Jobs

columns.name: SEEDED_FLAG
columns.description: Seeded Flag to indicate whether the job is a seeded job or not.

columns.name: VISIBLE_FLAG
columns.description: Visible Flag to indicate whether the job is going to be visible in the job listing page.

columns.name: NAME
columns.description: Export Job Name

columns.name: DESC_TEXT
columns.description: Job Description

columns.name: FILE_TYPE
columns.description: File export type, e.g. CSV (for future use XML)

columns.name: FILE_CHARSET
columns.description: Charset to use, e.g. UTF-8, UTF-16, etc.  Lookup to FND_LOOKUPS

columns.name: ERROR_THRESHOLD
columns.description: Number of errors to allow before aborting.  Null = no limit

columns.name: DELIMITER
columns.description: Delimiter to use, e.g. comma, tab

columns.name: QUOTE_CHAR
columns.description: Character(s) to use to encapsulate value if it contains the delimiter (e.g. double quote, single quote, null for nothing)

columns.name: END_OF_LINE
columns.description: End of Line Chararcter to use.  Lookup to be CR, LF, or CRLF.  Default: LF

columns.name: HEADER_ROW_INCLUDED
columns.description: Y/N to include the header row in the output

columns.name: NULL_VALUE
columns.description: The value to use to represent a null value.  If null itself no value is output.  Default: null

columns.name: COMPRESSION
columns.description: Compression options.  G=gzip individual files, Z=create single zip of all files, J=create single zip of all files

columns.name: ACTIVE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicate whether the task is active (registered within ESS)

columns.name: SCHEDULE_TYPE_CD
columns.description: SCHEDULE_TYPE_CD

columns.name: SCHEDULE_MODE_CD
columns.description: Schedule mode - repating, one time (manually), one time (scheduled)

columns.name: SCHEDULE_STATUS_CD
columns.description: Schedule status (scheduled, not scheduled, running, complete, error)

columns.name: START_TM
columns.description: Start date for schedule

columns.name: NEXT_SCHEDULE_TM
columns.description: Next scheduled date

columns.name: REPEAT_FREQUENCY
columns.description: Number of repeat frequency

columns.name: END_DATE_TM
columns.description: End date time

columns.name: REPEAT_UNIT_CD
columns.description: Repeat unit code (hours, days, weeks, months)

columns.name: EXPORT_MAP_ID
columns.description: Identifies the export mapping used for field mappings

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: PARENT_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Parent Scheduler Request in case of Repeating exports

columns.name: TIMESTAMP_FORMAT
columns.description: Timestamp Format

columns.name: DATE_FORMAT
columns.description: Date Format

columns.name: DECIMAL_SEPARATOR
columns.description: Decimal Separator

columns.name: LAST_BATCH_ID
columns.description: Most recently run batch

columns.name: LAST_BATCH_START_TM
columns.description: The last time a batch for this job was started

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: EXPORT_TYPE
columns.description: Export type specifies the type of export job, whether it is Standard or classic.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.
